name: Tunnel carrier, Lynden, Washington, July 2005 (silhouette only)
depiction: One of the three British Columbia men arrested and charged in July 2005 after agents watched them carry bags of marijuana through the tunnel from Aldergrove, BC, into a house in Lynden, Washington. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; a plain work jacket. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
